title: 约书亚树沙漠的日落颂歌

prompt._raw_prompt: 英文：Create a panoramic desert scene at sunset, with towering Joshua trees in the foreground, sandy terrain dotted with sparse shrubs, a sky filled with soft orange and purple-hued clouds, and the sun casting warm golden light over the landscape. Capture the serene yet dramatic atmosphere of the desert at dusk. 中文：绘制一幅日落时的沙漠全景，前景是高大的约书亚树，沙质地面散布着稀疏灌木，天空布满柔和橙紫色调的云朵，太阳将温暖的金色光线洒在大地上。捕捉黄昏时沙漠宁静却富有戏剧性的氛围。
